author: GenAiRanker

sections.description:
Buyers increasingly ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Grok and Google AI Overviews for recommendations instead of searching. GenAI Ranker is a Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) plugin that helps your site get named and recommended by AI.

Free, in this plugin:

  • Free AI-search visibility score — one click shows how AI portrays your site, with quick wins.
  • Serve llms.txt — a machine-readable summary AI crawlers use to understand your brand.
  • Inject JSON-LD structured data into every page so AI engines parse your facts correctly.
  • Apply recommended fixes surfaced right inside wp-admin.

With a connected GenAI Ranker account (free to start):

  • Track your visibility across all 6 AI engines, scored 0–100, monitored daily.
  • AI traffic & revenue attribution — see the real visits and revenue ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot and Claude send your site (the plugin adds the tracking automatically).
  • Competitor analysis — who AI recommends instead of you, and why.
  • Category benchmark — how your AI-search visibility compares to your industry.
  • Daily monitoring & alerts, forecasts, and full shareable white-label reports.
  • One-click fixes pushed back to your site.

This is GEO — Generative Engine Optimization, also called Answer Engine Optimization (AEO): the new SEO for AI assistants. As buyers shift from Google to ChatGPT and AI Overviews, GenAI Ranker makes sure your brand is the one AI recommends.

Create your free workspace at genairanker.com.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open GenAI Ranker in the wp-admin menu.
  3. Click Run my free GEO scan to see your score instantly.
  4. (Optional) Create a free account at genairanker.com, generate a connection token under Integrations, paste it here, and click Save & connect for full multi-engine tracking.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free?

Yes. The free score, llms.txt and JSON-LD are free. Full multi-engine tracking is a paid GenAI Ranker plan (free tier available).

Do I need an account to use it?

No — the free GEO scan and on-site GEO basics work without an account. An account unlocks tracking, competitors, alerts and reports.

What data is sent?

The free GEO scan sends only your site’s public domain to genairanker.com. If you connect an account, the plugin also exchanges your connection token with genairanker.com to sync recommended GEO assets and (when you choose to publish) receive page/post content to create as drafts on your site. When connected, an anonymous tracking pixel records which AI assistant referred a visit (no personal data) so you can see AI-driven traffic. This plugin relies on the third-party GenAI Ranker service (genairanker.com); see its Terms and Privacy Policy.

How do I get my site recommended by ChatGPT and other AI assistants?

Make your site legible to AI crawlers and authoritative on the questions buyers ask. This plugin serves an llms.txt, injects JSON-LD structured data, and (with an account) gives you a prioritized list of fixes plus tracking so you can see your visibility climb across all six engines.

What is llms.txt?

llms.txt is an emerging standard file (like robots.txt for AI) that tells AI assistants the canonical facts about your site. This plugin generates and serves yours at /llms.txt automatically.

Is GEO the same as SEO?

GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) is SEO for AI assistants. Traditional SEO targets Google’s blue links; GEO targets being named and recommended inside ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Grok and Google AI Overviews. You need both.
sections.changelog:
1.5.0

  • Fix: “Run my free GEO scan” now opens your instant scan on genairanker.com in a new tab instead of running it synchronously on your server — so it no longer fails silently on hosts with a short PHP execution limit.
  • Much easier setup: a guided 3-step connect flow with crisp instructions and a direct link to grab your token.
  • The confusing “Workspace URL” field is moved to Advanced settings with a clear “leave as-is” note — most users never touch it.
  • Token field is now the first, primary input; Agent-optimized delivery is marked Recommended with clearer benefit copy.

1.4.1

  • Hardening: an unexpected content “format” on the publish endpoint now defaults to escaped text instead of passing raw HTML through (the two rich formats, markdown/html, are unchanged and still run through wp_kses_post).
  • Hardening: the Connection token field in settings is now masked (password input).
  • Fix: internal version constant now matches the plugin version.

1.4.0

  • New: optional “Agent-optimized delivery”. When enabled, AI answer/training bots (GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, OAI-SearchBot and more) are served a clean, token-stripped facts page for your brand — easier for AI to read and cite. Humans and Google/Bing always see your normal site, so SEO is unaffected. Off by default; enable it in the plugin settings.

1.3.1

  • Compatibility: marked tested up to WordPress 7.0.
  • Housekeeping: aligned the text domain with the plugin slug.

1.3.0

  • WooCommerce: automatically inject GEO-complete Product structured data (Product + Offer + AggregateRating — name, image, price, availability, SKU, brand, ratings) on single-product pages, so AI assistants can recommend your products with price and availability. Active only when WooCommerce is installed.

1.2.4

  • The AI-referral pixel is now loaded with wp_enqueue_script (with async and its token added via script_loader_tag) instead of being printed directly into the page head — per WordPress.org plugin guidelines.

1.2.3

  • Auto-injects the GenAI Ranker AI-referral pixel so traffic and revenue from AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot, Claude) appear in your AI-traffic report — no manual snippet needed.

1.2.2

  • Added a wp-admin dashboard widget showing your AI-search visibility score and top fixes at a glance.

1.2.1

  • /llms.txt now sends a 24-hour Cache-Control header to cut redundant AI-crawler fetches.
  • Keeps serving the last-synced llms.txt and JSON-LD through a temporary sync hiccup (shown as “stale” rather than failing).
  • Hardened link rendering in applied content (URLs escaped).

1.2.0

  • Added one-click publishing: approved GEO assets from your GenAI Ranker workspace can be created as drafts/posts on your site.
  • Hardened the connection endpoint and token handling.

1.1.0

  • Added free in-dashboard GEO visibility score.
  • Pointed to genairanker.com; added upsell to full multi-engine tracking.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: serve llms.txt, inject JSON-LD, sync recommendations.
